feeds.title: Mokum Surf Club Blog
feeds.description: Mokum Surf Club is a Surf, Travel & Lifestyle Blog for the adventurous globetrotter. Be inspired to surf and travel. Mokum Surf Club Blog features articles on their travel stories, adventures, surf locations, guides, unique destinations, and surf lifestyle. Get inspired and go surf! They specialize in crafting unforgettable journeys along the untamed waves. Dive into our world of off-the-grid Surf & Yoga Retreats, where adventure meets tranquillity.

feeds.title: I Love The Seaside
feeds.description: ILovetheSeaside.com is a continuous inspirational platform for all seaside-loving people travelling and surfing the shores of Europe. Read interviews, reviews, blogs, meet local people before your journey starts, find your place to stay, discover small brands and artists or share your adventures.

feeds.title: Surf Escape
feeds.description: Surf Escape surfers from Europe. Family men and -women that love nature. And love to explore new surf destinations. As they have been in the ocean since the 70's we've got a lot to share.

feeds.title: Puskas Surf Shop Blog
feeds.description: In 1973, just 6 short years into shortboard revolution, an era of radical change and fine tuning, a family of board builders in the Basque Country (Spain) entered the picture, and Pukas Surf was formed in 1979.

feeds.title: European Surfing Federation
feeds.description: The ESF was formed in 1972,when surfing in Europe was still a new and undeveloped activity….when each Country was 'going it alone' in organising their National Surfing Championships…before communicating became so easy…before even videos of surfing were available never mind live webcasts. Their mission is to establish and maintain a EUROPEAN SURFING FEDERATION to promote the interests of surfing in all its forms throughout all the countries of Europe.

feeds.title: Rapture Surfcamps Blog
feeds.description: Rapturecamps is a network of five surf camps located on three different continents. Their main goal is to offer exceptional surf vacations, lessons, and guidance in small and personalized camps to people from all around the world. Their have an informative blog that covers everything from tips for surfers to ultimate surf break guides, global surfing news, and destination guides. Rapture Surfcamps blog is the top surf blog for all surfers!

feeds.title: Chicks On Waves Blog
feeds.description: I am Katrien, the founder, and owner of Chicks On Waves. I am a mom of 2 little boys with a passion for surfing and the ocean. I started surfing 18 years ago at the age of 25 in Portugal and fell in love with the sport. Since then I was totally hooked, trying to surf whenever and where ever I could. When I started Chicks On Waves 14 years ago, I wanted to get more girls in the water. Because everyone can learn to surf!

feeds.description: The CNP is a non-profit institution whose objective is the cultural, sporting and recreational promotion of its members. Providing you with eco and sustainable news on a regular basis but also interesting posts about our initiatives in the Algarve coast as well.

feeds.description: Marlene On The Move offers travel-related information, tips, and inspiration for adventurers. It covers topics such as surf travel, destinations for digital nomads, and California road trips.

feeds.description: Book the best day trips in Albufeira. Surf and Standup Paddle lessons. Board rentals. Kayak trips to hidden beaches and Algarve's caves.

feeds.title: Red Star Surf Blog
feeds.description: Community Values they believe people can do more together than alone and that each of us plays an important role in helping to create a safe and respectful community. So, they laid out a set of principles for us to follow on this Page: Let's celebrate the things that bring us together. Let's choose to treat each other like neighbors rather than strangers. Let's respect individuality and welcome diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Let's assume people mean well. Our moderators are here for the community to uphold these values every day.

feeds.title: Surf4 You Blog
feeds.description: Combining a taste for the Sea and Surf, and to help people in their personal development, Surf4 You appears as a solution for all those who, through a surf session, can collect the necessary tools to contemplate daily life in a confident way. We want each one to reach the perfect union with the ocean through the practice of a sport and art that is Surf.At Surf4 You, through a personalized/flexible learning pace and according to your needs, we focus on achieving your goals, so that every moment we provide is useful in your personal and professional life.
